Sheet.Name: Name
Sheet.ManaHint: Current mana / max mana. Max mana is enhanced Intelligence plus buffs.
Sheet.ShieldSlotHint: Click to spend this shield slot
Sheet.FillDamageDone: Filled damage for {count} skills and spells.

Stat.ActionsHint: Actions each round: 2, plus Extra Actions effects.
Stat.ShieldDrHint: Shield DR from your equipped shield. Use − when it absorbs damage and + to restore it.

Health.Hint: Click a slot to set health there. Each slot's number is the damage it takes to lose it (CON mod plus bonuses).

Hotlist.Empty: Drag items here to pin them to the hotlist.
Hotlist.Hint: Pin items with the pin icon, or drop them here or on the Actions tab icon.

Empty.Skills: No skills yet. Drag one in from a compendium.
Empty.Inherent: No inherent spells. Add an "Inherent Spell" rule to an effect, or set a spell's usage to Inherent.

Item.RankHint: Base rank; the arrow shows the rank after effects.
Item.SkillHint: Skill name, or blank for STR/DEX
Item.AreaHint: Hits an area. Targets with a halve-area-damage effect take half.
Item.HealingHint: Health slots restored. RANK and RANK_DIE (Core Rulebook p.176) use the current Rank.
Item.Name: Name

Effect.Title: Effects
Effect.ApplyHint: Not applied to the owner. Drag it onto a target's sheet or token to apply it.
Effect.ItemHint: Effects that apply to the owner are active while the item is held (weapons, equipment and tattoos must be equipped). Effects with a rank requirement switch on when the skill or spell reaches that rank.

Spell.NotFound: No spell with this name was found in the world or compendia.

Mob.StatBudgetHint: Mobs get 3 stat points per level; bosses get their tier's points per level.

Npc.DropMob: Drop a Mob actor here to use it as this NPC's stat block.

Roll.StatHint: Roll a check. Shift-click to skip the dialog.
Roll.EvadeHint: Roll Evade. Shift-click to skip the dialog.
Roll.NoTargets: No targets. Target tokens before attacking to see hit or miss.

Damage.BlockHint: Shield Block: turn on after a successful Shield Block check. Halves the damage (from Rank 15, minus STR too).
Damage.BlockUnavailable: Shield Block can't stop area damage, or magic below Rank 5.

Combat.NoMobAttacks: No mob with an attack is in this combat.
Combat.BlockHint: Roll Shield Block against the attack. A success still hits, but the damage is halved when applied.
Combat.CannotBlock: Shield Block needs the Shield Block skill and an equipped shield, and can't stop area damage (or magic below Rank 5).
Combat.ResolveHint: Roll damage for every target that was hit. Unanswered targets count as tanking.

Frames.Title: Crawlers
Frames.SettingHint: Show the party's Health and Mana frames beside the scene list.
Frames.DragHealth: Drag to set Health in 10% steps (arrow keys work too)

Upkeep.Title: Upkeep: {name}
Upkeep.Hint: Rests restore health and mana and clear some debuffs. Advancement rolls d20 for each marked skill and spell.
Upkeep.PointsWaiting: {points} stat points waiting to be assigned.
Upkeep.FloorThree: Stat points can be assigned from floor 3.
Upkeep.GMRequired: The GM has not enabled player upkeep.
Upkeep.NoTime: Player upkeep changes recovery and progress without advancing time.
Upkeep.PlayerSetting: Allow player upkeep without time skips
Upkeep.PlayerSettingHint: Players may run upkeep for crawlers they own. Only the GM can advance the clock.
Upkeep.UntrainedHint: Choose one marked Rank 0 skill to learn at Rank 1. All other untrained skills are removed, as in CrawlSpace.
Upkeep.Learned: Learned {name} at Rank 1; other untrained skills removed.

AutoAdvance.Name: Auto-advance combat phases
AutoAdvance.Hint: Move to the next phase as soon as everyone on the acting side is done.

Warn.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to do that.
Warn.MacroOwned: That macro needs an item owned by an actor.
Warn.Tainted: {name} has The Taint and can't be healed.
Warn.SpellNotFound: Could not find a spell named {name}.

Ids.Title: Identifiers
Ids.UuidHint: Unique to this document in this world. Use it in @UUID links and macros.
Ids.SourceIdHint: The compendium entry this was created from, if any.
Ids.CrawlSpaceHint: The CrawlSpace database row this was imported from (database:id).

RowConfig.DamageHint: Leave blank to use the weapon or skill damage.

Time.Title: Time & Timers
Time.ClockHint: 30-hour days. Exploration runs in real time when enabled. Foundry pause stops the clock; combat advances 10 seconds per round.
Time.Label: Name
Time.SkipHint: Advance time once for everyone. Select crawlers for recovery or safe-room advancement. Short, long, and full rests use fixed lengths; other activities use the hours below. Grinding here advances time only.
Time.GMOnly: The GM advances shared time. Ask the GM to include your crawler in Time & Timers.
Time.InvalidDuration: Enter a valid duration or whole number of hours.
Time.Busy: A time skip is already in progress.
Time.InCombat: End combat before resting or skipping hours. Advance combat rounds in the tracker.
Time.SelectActors: Select the crawlers participating in this activity.

Event.healed: Heal at least one health slot

Time.FloorPrompt: Set the remaining time before this floor collapses. A dungeon day lasts 30 hours.
Time.OverflowHint: Overflow is converted automatically: 90 minutes becomes 1 hour 30 minutes; 30 hours becomes 1 day.

Grinding.Title: Grinding
Grinding.Hint: The first five hours are productive. Additional hours require Endurance checks; failures add Fatigued. Assign the productive hours to skills and spells, then resolve daily advancement checks.
Grinding.NewDay: Start a new grinding day (keep banked progress)
Grinding.DayError: {name} would exceed 30 grinding hours today. Start a new grinding day first.
Grinding.EnduranceError: Add Endurance to {name} before overtime grinding.
Grinding.AllocateError: Assign exactly {hours} whole hours, within the displayed limits.
Grinding.LevelResult: Gained {gained} levels; now Level {level}. Stat points are banked.
Grinding.Summary: {hours} actual hours; {productive} productive hours today; {level} hours banked toward the next level.
Grinding.Changed: Grinding progress changed while this session was open. Reopen upkeep before confirming.

Awards.Title: Crawler Awards
Awards.NumberHint: Enter a total, or use +5 / -2 to adjust the current value. Leave blank to keep it.
Awards.DropAchievement: Or drop an achievement from a compendium here.
Awards.name: Achievement name
Awards.Link: Link the reward to the awarded loot box
Awards.PreparedHint: Choose a loot box with prepared contents, or drop one here.
Awards.NamedHint: The box's contents are rolled for its tier and type when it is opened.
Awards.GenerateFirst: Generate the box first, or choose another loot box source.
Awards.NotPrepared: {name} has no prepared contents. Use Prepare contents on its sheet first.
Awards.GoldNotAllowed: {gold} Gold can't be awarded on this crawler's floor. Award the box without the Gold?
Awards.UndoHint: Remove this award's items and restore AI Favor and Popularity
Awards.UndoOpened: This loot box was opened or removed, so the award can no longer be undone.
Awards.InvalidNumber: Enter a number or a modifier such as +5 or -2.
Awards.InvalidQuantity: Enter a loot box name and a whole quantity from 1 to 9999.

Loot.FloorSetting: Floor for X values and Gold
Loot.EarthHint: One Earth Hobby Potion. No ordinary Silver generation or Gold.
Loot.DropItems: Drop items from a compendium or the sidebar to add them.
Loot.SealedHint: Items and Gold stay sealed until the box is opened.
Loot.PreparedHint: These exact contents are awarded later; nothing is rerolled.
Loot.RollsOnOpen: Nothing prepared: the contents roll for the box's tier and type when it is opened.
Loot.OpenConfirm: Open {quantity} × {name} now? Boxes usually open during Safe Room upkeep.
Loot.NoPending: No loot boxes waiting to open

Minion.Label: Minion
Minion.Locked: A raised minion can be moved and rolled for, but only the GM can change it.
Minion.NoToken: {name} has no token on a scene to raise.
Minion.Raised: {name} rises as {caster}'s minion with {health} of {max} Health slots.

Ended.died: {name} dies again; the minion is gone.
Ended.ended: The condition holding {name} ends; it falls dead.

Companion.Title: Pets, Mounts & Minions
Companion.NoMaster: Follows no crawler. Drop a crawler here to link one.
Companion.DropHint: Drop a pet, mount or minion actor here, or make one.

Builder.Title: Character Builder
Builder.Name: Crawler name
Builder.NumberHint: The book suggests 500,000–12,900,000. Your GM may assign another number.
Builder.BackgroundHint: Choose one background per stage, then two different skills from each. Skills cannot repeat across backgrounds. Animal crawlers require your GM's agreement.
Builder.CombatIntro: You receive {attack} at Rank 3. Choose one additional combat option at Rank 3.
Builder.EffectHint: Also grants the {effect} damage-effect skill at Rank 3 and the Unarmed Combat achievement with a Bronze Weapon Box reward.
Builder.SpellHint: Requires INT 4 or higher. Includes five Standard Mana Potions and adds the spell and potions to the hotlist.
Builder.MatchHint: Matching skills, spells and weapons copy their compendium properties. A missing match creates an entry with only its name and starting rank.
Builder.StatHint: Roll all five stats or each stat on its own; you may reroll any stat. Every roll is posted to chat. Only unenhanced scores are set; the sheet works out the rest.
Builder.RollMismatch: {stat} does not match your latest stat roll in chat. Roll it again.
Builder.WeaponAdded: Your starting weapon will be added: {name}.
Builder.GearHint: Useful and weird items are created exactly as named, with blank properties. Starting clothing and weapons use a matching compendium entry when there is one.
Builder.Derived: Evade modifier +{evade}. Health: full (10 slots), {perSlot} per slot. Mana {mana}. Base Move 20 feet, Step 10 feet. Skill and equipment modifiers apply on the sheet.
Builder.StoryDeferred: Deferred; fill this out on the sheet later.
Builder.SentToGM: Your crawler has gone to the GM to be created.
Builder.NoUser: That user is no longer in this world.

Build.Capped: Detriments total {earned} points; only 5 can raise this build's budget.
Build.PoolHint: Races get 25 points and classes 30, plus up to 5 from detriments. Unspent points are lost. A build with rule checks can still be saved for the GM to review.
Build.StatHint: Each +1 costs a point; every 2 points of stat penalties earn 1 back. DR costs 2 points per +1, up to +3. Stat, skill, spell and DR bonuses go on this item's Build effect automatically.
Build.AllSkillHint: Each −1 to every skill under a stat earns 1 point.

Hint.skillBonuses: Standard and passive ranks cost 2 points each; unusual or racial skill ranks cost 4. Drop skills here to link them.
Hint.spellBonuses: Each rank costs 2 points. A class can grant at most 5 passive ranks across its skills and spells. Drop spells here to link them.
Hint.skillDetriments: A penalty must apply to an existing skill and can't exceed its current rank. Every 2 points of penalties earn 1 point. Drop skills here to link them.
Hint.benefits: Pick a template, then describe the target and conditions. Agree custom tiers with the GM. Cosmetic traits are free.
Hint.detriments: A build gains at most 5 extra points from detriments.

Build.DropSkill: Drop a skill here, or add one by hand.
Build.DropSpell: Drop a spell here, or add one by hand.
Build.WrongDrop: Only a {type} can go in this list.
Build.AlienHint: Alien races can earn popularity and can't choose Earth classes.
Build.EarthHint: Earth races can choose Earth classes and get a Silver Earth Box with a Hobby Potion granting 3 skill ranks.
Build.BackgroundSkillsHint: Crawlers taking this background pick two of these skills in the character builder.
Build.DropOne: Drop a {kinds} here to link it.

Mechanic.rankCap: Linked skills can reach rank 20 (from floor 7).
Mechanic.allRankCaps: All skills can reach rank 20 (from floor 7).
Mechanic.skillBonus: Each linked skill gets +1 rank per count.
Mechanic.resistance: The crawler resists the linked damage types.
Mechanic.immunity: The crawler is immune to the linked damage types and conditions.
Mechanic.vulnerability: The crawler is vulnerable to the linked damage types.
Mechanic.advanceBonus: +1 per count on end-of-floor advancement checks for linked skills.
Mechanic.advanceAdvantage: Advantage on advancement checks for the linked skill.
Mechanic.advancePenalty: −1 per count on advancement checks for the linked skill once it is rank 5 or higher.
